title: Easy Kitchen Lab
challenge: Tasked with finishing key features on an e-commerce platform, including the payment system, order notifications, SEO enhancements, and checkout redesign. Also needed to improve performance by optimizing API logic and implementing caching, all without breaking existing functionality.
solution: Added Stripe card payments alongside the existing PayPal method and ensured backend price validation to prevent tampering. Redesigned the checkout modal for a more approachable user experience. Optimized checkout waiting times by switching from the Selenium script to the WooCommerce API and implemented Redis caching. Added SEO and AEO meta tags, including a FAQ section, and integrated Google Analytics tracking to monitor user interactions and conversion metrics.

title: Fermicoding
challenge: Tasked with improving the website to attract potential clients, focusing on content organization, user experience, and responsiveness.
solution: Added a new taxonomy page for industries, showing recent news and related projects for each. Also, enhanced Used Services filters using taxonomies. Redesigned the footer and client testimonials section, making it a reusable block for any page. Made the banner slides mobile responsive.

title: Taglient Games
challenge: Needed a website to showcase my game development brand and projects, while also learning React and exploring frontend/backend separation and hosting.
solution: Built the website with a React frontend and Express.js backend - for the contact form. Learned to handle API communication between frontend and backend, host both on Vercel, and resolve CORS errors. Gained hands-on experience with React components and making the site fully responsive.
